Day 1/16 · Japan Trip visualised 🇯🇵

Started as a memory map, the geotagged-photo kind, for a 16-day trip.

First concept had every day, every stop.

Somehow it came out looking like a corporate expense dashboard.

Nobody asked for that. Fixing it now.
#buildinpublic #uxdesign
note: Posted by hand before this tool existed. Text transcribed from a profile screenshot; link and time not recorded.
